title: Audit teardown adapters and evidence validator review fixes

source_findings_list.note: prompt.txt is referenced by card specs P1-PRE/P1-GOV but exists nowhere on disk, and the proposal never enumerates the 4 critical / 4 high findings. The severity ledger below is derived from the integration code plus the preserved regression tests; it is this card's classification, not a transcription.

evidence_suite.note: failures dominated by 'unexpected-field': the preserved tests change the manifest schema, not only the reader

critical.title: Kubernetes namespace lookup failure (incl. 403 Forbidden) reported as absence
critical.signature: namespace_exists returns result.returncode == 0; any non-zero exit (Forbidden, auth, API down) => False => NAMESPACE stage believes namespace deleted
critical.required_behaviour: kubectl get namespace <ns> --ignore-not-found -o name: empty stdout + rc 0 => absent; 'namespace/<ns>' => present; non-zero => raise (message must contain 'namespace_lookup_failed'; SP-P1 names the type TeardownAuthorizationError for 403)

critical.title: Tailscale inventory fail-open on missing 'devices' collection
critical.signature: self._request(...).get('devices', []) => {} yields [] => MeshAdapter reports 'tenant Tailscale nodes absent by API' success

critical.title: SPIRE inventory fail-open on missing 'entries' collection
critical.signature: payload.get('entries', []) => '{}' yields [] => SPIRE entries considered removed

critical.title: Mesh deletion by hostname alone, without ownership attribution
critical.signature: _tenant_nodes matches hostname prefix sl-eap-<hash> and delete_node is called on every match; an unowned or workstation device with a colliding name is deleted
critical.required_behaviour: MeshAdapter(client, ownership=...) ; no ownership record => fail 'ownership_inventory_missing' ; matched device id not in owned device_ids => fail 'mesh_ownership_collision' ; zero deletes in both cases

high.title: SPIFFE matcher is a substring test across trust domains
high.signature: marker '/ns/eap-<hash>/' in str(spiffe_id) matches spiffe://evil/... and spiffe://signalloom.demo/x/ns/...; object-form spiffe_id only matches by accident of str(dict)
high.required_behaviour: parse both string and {trust_domain,path} forms; exact trust domain signalloom.demo and path prefix /ns/eap-<hash>/

high.title: OpenBao client accepts plaintext HTTP for the X-Vault-Token
high.required_behaviour: ValueError matching 'HTTPS' unless scheme is https; SP-P1 additionally requires post-shred GET 404 to confirm, and 403/500 to fail the stage with a distinct detail (no preserved test covers this: P1-1 must add one)

high.title: Unbounded HTTP transport: slow-drip body and redirect-following with secret headers
high.signature: urllib.request.urlopen timeout is per-socket-operation, so a 1-byte drip never trips it; response.read() is unbounded; default opener follows 3xx
high.required_behaviour: new adapters.BoundedHTTPTransport(allow_http_loopback=, max_body_bytes=) with request(method,url,headers,body,timeout); total-deadline 'http_deadline_exceeded' (<1s for 0.2s budget); 3xx => 'http_redirect_rejected'

high.title: Raw provider exception text copied into StageResult detail
high.signature: except Exception as error: StageResult(stage, False, str(error)) persists e.g. 'X-Vault-Token=...' into evidence/audit

additional_medium.title: PV observation reported as storage erasure proof
additional_medium.signature: storage_absence_proof returns verified: not retained, so no PVs means verified=True

additional_medium.title: No read-only verify() in the stage executor contract
additional_medium.signature: StageExecutor/ConfiguredTeardownExecutor/FailClosedExecutor expose execute only; verification re-runs mutation
additional_medium.required_behaviour: verify(self, stage, request) on protocol and both executors; verify never calls execute; FailClosedExecutor.verify fails

adapter_findings.regression_catalog_complete: 13 review-regression tests + 1 contract assertion map 1:1 onto C1-C4, H1-H4, M1-M2; none is unmapped

evidence_verifier_finding.defect: Size check and read are two separate path resolutions: args.manifest.stat().st_size (follows symlinks) then args.manifest.read_text() (re-opens by path, unbounded).
exploits: TOCTOU: file replaced or grown between stat and read => unbounded read, memory exhaustion
symlink followed at both calls => verifier reads an arbitrary target the operator did not name
FIFO: st_size 0 passes the check, read_text blocks forever (hang, no exit code)
character device such as /dev/zero: st_size 0 passes, read_text unbounded

stat_vs_descriptor_comparison.current_stat_then_read_text: two lookups, follows symlinks, trusts st_size as a proxy for bytes read, blocks on FIFOs, no file-type check
stat_vs_descriptor_comparison.required_descriptor_safe: os.lstat(path) -> os.open(path, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC) -> os.fstat(fd): require S_ISREG and (st_dev, st_ino) equal to the lstat result -> os.read(fd) in a loop until MAX+1 bytes -> reject if more than MAX -> close in finally

preserved_test_contract.helper: module-level _read_manifest(path); module must import os as an attribute (tests patch validator.os.lstat)

spec_tightening.issue: Row says 'integrate 31 test assertions'; the preserved suite has 48 tests (31 existing + 17 new), and 42 of them fail against current code
spec_tightening.issue_detail: The preserved tests also change the manifest schema: fixture attribution (fixture_id, tenant_kind, tenant_id, resource_id, expected_resource_ids, expected_preinventory, sentinel_fixture), freshness window, run-duration bound and strict RFC 3339. New codes: fixture-attribution-mismatch, sentinel-attribution-mismatch, non-synthetic-sentinel, preinventory-mismatch, stale-observation, run-duration-exceeded.
spec_tightening.recommendation: P1-2 scope = descriptor-safe reader AND manifest schema v2; size M still plausible, but the Governor should accept the scope widening explicitly

spec_tightening.issue: SP-P1 names fixture prefix sled-cert-*, but the code and the preserved tests key Tailscale nodes on hostname sl-eap-<hash> plus an ownership inventory {device_ids, tag}
spec_tightening.recommendation: Implement the ownership-inventory model the tests pin (detail codes ownership_inventory_missing / mesh_ownership_collision). Treat sled-cert-<run-id> as the P4 fixture attribution that populates the ownership inventory, not as a second hostname matcher. The Governor must confirm.

spec_tightening.issue: SP-P1 names TeardownAuthorizationError; the test matches only the message 'namespace_lookup_failed'
spec_tightening.recommendation: raise TeardownAuthorizationError('namespace_lookup_failed: forbidden') for 403 and a generic lookup error with the same prefix otherwise, which satisfies both

spec_tightening.issue: SP-P1 OpenBao clause (post-shred 404 confirmation; 403/500 fail the stage) has no preserved test; current key_exists/secret_exists treat 403 as 'still exists', which fails closed but with a misleading detail. delete_tenant_material raises on 404 from the config POST, so a retry after a partial shred is non-idempotent.
spec_tightening.recommendation: P1-1 adds tests: verify 403 => stage fail detail 'openbao_authorization_failed'; 500 => fail; retry after key already gone => success
